title: Quick Bite
description: Quick Bite reduces the time it takes for fish to bite your hook, making fishing faster and more enjoyable.
body:
### **🎣 Quick Bite**

Tired of waiting for fish to bite?

Quick Bite is a lightweight Fabric mod that reduces the waiting time before a fish bites your fishing hook, making fishing much faster while keeping the vanilla mechanics intact.

Features
⚡ Fish bite in 1–5 seconds instead of 5–30 seconds.
🎣 Works just like vanilla Minecraft.
🪶 Lightweight with no unnecessary features.
🔧 Designed for players who simply want faster fishing.
Planned Features
Config file to customize the minimum and maximum bite time.
Mod Menu integration.
Toggle Lure enchantment effects.
Toggle rain effects.
Support for future Minecraft versions.
Compatibility
Minecraft: 26.1.2
Mod Loader: Fabric
Why Quick Bite?

This mod was created with one simple goal:

Make fishing faster without changing how fishing works.

🐛 Found a bug?

💡 Have an idea?
Suggestions are always welcome!
